privileged_info_for_vlm: The dataset contains 12 participants total. 'sub-99999' is a contaminated participant with robotic reaction times (<100ms) and must be excluded from group means but included in the JSON with an 'excluded' flag. Valid participants should have their RT switch cost calculated as (mean_rt_switch - mean_rt_repeat) and Accuracy switch cost as (accuracy_repeat - accuracy_switch). Trials where trial_type is 'FIRST' or rt_ms is 0 must be ignored for all calculations.
